[NDLC.2.4] A dialect setting `call`, `publish`, `cache` and
`cache_delete` `false` — and with them every capability that depends
on `call` ([LCAP.3.8]) — is valid: it produces a read-only dialect, with
no writes and no calls. `cached(...)` reads still work, because reads are
not gateable ([NDLC.3.1]).
